svg.title: Grouped education: lower and upper levels
svg.desc: Four-tile grouped treemap. Lower education combines compulsory school and apprenticeship or VET; upper education combines Matura and university or college degree. Parents increase left to right and children bottom to top. Each of the four original parent categories receives equal weight. These merged percentages are illustrative, not population-weighted estimates.

svg.text: Grouped education: lower and upper levels
Austria. Illustrative merged percentages, with equal weights for original parent groups.
Each column combines two parent levels. Children: compulsory + VET at the bottom; Matura + degree at the top.
Equal weight for the four original parent groups; illustrative merged shares, not population-weighted estimates.
Statistics Austria, Adult Education Survey 2007, 2011/12, 2016/17, 2022/23; Bildung in Zahlen 2018/19 and 2024/25, table 5.1_9a.
Parents' education is the higher of mother and father. Degree includes colleges; 2007 and 2011/12 group it slightly differently.
